g.text: One Vite app, three FastAPI services, loopback only, synthetic data
three FastAPI apps, one port each
the only things that outlive a request
the API projects a graph and plans
No provider call, no vector store, no authentication. A loopback listener bounds blast radius; it is
not an authorization boundary, and nothing here is production software.
Read from README.md, backend/app/main.py, policy_api.py, policy_demo_api.py, vite.config.ts on 2026-10-30.
